name: arms stretch on a support
description: Resting your arms on a support and sinking down stretches the biceps and front of the shoulders. The support does part of the work for you.
instructions: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
